title: FIN Logger v1.3.4.1
changelog:
Fix FIN Logger icon on v1.3.4.1

Replace the launcher artwork with the correctly cropped FIN Logger icon, inset it into Android's adaptive-icon safe zone, keep visible versionName 1.3.4.1, raise versionCode to 12, and make in-app update checks honor versionCode so existing 1.3.4.1 installs can receive the corrected build.
